## 2. What to build

**§6 Reactions and emoji** (prototype frame 5)
- **Custom workspace emoji** (CH16b, right after the hackathon cut): any member unless a role switch restricts it; PNG, GIF or WebP up to 256 KB, shown up to 128 px; `:name:`; animated ones play only on hover and never with reduced motion; Settings → Chat → Custom emoji lists them with who added each, admins remove any; part of the export.

**§15 Settings, and where each thing lives**
- **Settings → Chat:** your quick reactions · Custom emoji (the workspace's list) · "Show me as online" · "Show what I'm focusing on".

**§12 table rows**
| Action | Admin | Manager | Author | Member | Viewer | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Add a custom emoji | with "Add custom emoji" (admins and members by default) | | | | — | CH16b |
| Remove a custom emoji | ✓ | — | own | — | — | CH16b |

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC4 — A developer team's week**
- **AC4.8** a custom emoji `:shipit:` added by a member shows first in the picker, in reactions and on task comments.

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `supabase/tests/chat_emoji.test.sql` · "custom emoji rules" · proves AC4.8 · Name rules, 256 KB, no SVG, 500 per workspace, the switch; removal soft-deletes; the poster frame exists.
- `tests/chat-emoji.spec.ts` · "custom emoji in the picker, reactions and comments" · proves AC4.8 · A member adds `:shipit:`; it appears first in the picker, works as a reaction in chat and on a task comment, plays only on hover, and reads as text once removed.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **Table** `chat_custom_emoji` (round-3 §2.9, §2.2; #18): `id, workspace_id, name, storage_path, poster_path, mime, width, height, bytes, animated, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at`; `name` matches `^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`, unique per workspace among live rows; soft deletes (the delta and Realtime see a removal); members of the workspace read it (the plan isn't required: paused chat still reads); published, filtered by workspace; own Realtime channel; writes only through ops.
- **Bucket** `chat-emoji`, private: PNG, GIF, WebP, 256 KB, **no SVG**; paths `<workspace>/<sha256>.<ext>` and `<workspace>/<sha256>.poster.png` (the still frame for "plays on hover only"). Policies: insert only into your own workspace's folder, with the custom-emoji switch; read by members of that workspace. A new bucket needs `type` and upsert needs SELECT + INSERT + UPDATE (`docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Upload flow:** the browser decodes, scales a still image to 128 px, refuses an animated one over 128 px or 256 KB, makes the poster, uploads both, then `chat_op_custom_emoji_add(ws, name, path, poster_path, mime, width, height, bytes, animated)` checks the name, type, size, that both objects exist and the limit of **500 per workspace**. `chat_op_custom_emoji_remove(id)` soft-deletes: its adder, or an admin. Activity `chat.emoji_add` / `chat.emoji_remove` (#15); both need the plan.
- **The switch:** `add_emoji` on `workspace_chat_caps` (on for admins and members, off for viewers), in `CHAT_CAPABILITIES` and `chat_caps_get`. CV-15 shows it in the role editor: whichever of CV-15 and CV-20 lands first adds the column, the other checks the catalog and skips (ask the orchestrator).
- **In text and reactions:** `:name:` is resolved when drawn; a deleted emoji reads as its text. CV-7c's `reactions__key_ok` stays a shape check; `chat_op_react` and `comments_op_react` (both **live bodies**) additionally accept a `:name:` key only when it names a live emoji of that message's or comment's workspace (round-3 §2.8).
- **Client** (§6): the picker (CV-7b's Frimousse) lists the workspace's emoji first; `:` opens emoji with the custom ones first; shown up to 128 px; **animated ones play only on hover and never with reduced motion** (use the poster); Settings → Chat → Custom emoji (CV-7c's section) lists them with who added each, admins remove any. Comments draw `:name:` too (`src/features/spine/reactions.ts`, `src/features/tasks/ui/task-feed.tsx`).
- **Erasure and export** (#31): an account's deletion sets `created_by` to null (the emoji stay with the workspace: `account_erase_workspace_data`, live body); the export carries the images (CV-22 writes the files).

## 7. Watch out

- Round-3 §5 risk 2: `comments_op_react` and `account_erase_workspace_data` are shared; read their live bodies.
- **Tier 2** (migrations, RLS, contracts, moduo-mcp, src/lib/runtime*): one `/code-review high` and one security scan of the diff at the end; scan findings go only into the hand-back.
- **Migration:** stamp provisional (re-cut on apply day, chat's order kept); redefine from live bodies (`pg_get_functiondef`); re-state grants by name (`DROP` + `CREATE` resets them); re-assert the Realtime publication if you publish a table; apply only on your migration turn, then `bun run db:test chat`; never `local:reset` or `migration up` (runbook, `docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Hot files:** `src/lib/runtime.chat.web.ts` and `src/features/tasks/ui/task-feed.tsx` (Tasks' comment UI). Keep edits there small; another builder may change them too.
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.
